title: Add a real logger instead of console logging everywhere
description: The codebase currently uses console.error/console.log directly in many modules. We should introduce a proper logger abstraction so messages can be routed, formatted, and silenced in tests and production. This issue covers adding the logger, replacing direct console usage, and updating tests so they do not depend on console output.

title: Research openai SDK features vs plain fetch for goal requests
description: requestGoals in src/plan/goals/request.ts uses plain fetch. Research which openai SDK features we lack: retries/backoff, timeout handling, typed errors, streaming. Decide whether to reintroduce the SDK or build what's needed.
